question: Seven people - A, C, G, K, M, R and V are sitting in a straight line facing North. As many people sit to the left of A as to the right of A. C sits second to the right of A. Only three people sit between C and G. K is not an immediate neighbour of G. M sits second to the right of K. R does not sit at any of the extreme ends of the line. How many people sit between V and R?
solution: **Given: **Seven people - A, C, G, K, M, R and V are sitting in a straight line facing North. 1) As many people sit to the left of A as to the right of A. 2) C sits second to the right of A. 3) Only three people sit between C and G.
